description: Three-panel TEM figure on Fe–30Mn–11Al–1.2C (wt%) low-density steel after cold rolling. (a) Dark-field TEM micrograph (200 nm scale bar, bottom right) showing bright, closely spaced parallel nano-twin lamellae running diagonally through a dark matrix; the inset SAED pattern at top right shows discrete sharp spots, six of them joined by a green dashed hexagon with green arrows marking individual reflections. (b) Bright-field TEM micrograph (1 µm scale bar): a band bounded by two parallel blue dashed lines and labelled "shear band" in blue crosses the heavily deformed matrix diagonally, while green arrows labelled "twins" mark fine twin laths; a red-boxed "A" marks the area whose selected-area diffraction pattern is inset at top right, showing concentric continuous rings around the transmitted beam, i.e. ultrafine grains. (c) Bright-field micrograph (1 µm scale bar) of 90% rolled material, showing dark, dense, elongated dislocation-tangle and cell walls in a lighter matrix. Together the panels document the deformation-sequence argument: nano-twins (a) plus micro-shear bands made of ultrafine grains (b) at 70% reduction, then dislocation tangles/cells (c) at 90% reduction.

subfigures.description: Dark-field TEM micrograph with a 200 nm scale bar, showing bright, closely spaced parallel nano-twin lamellae on a dark matrix; inset SAED pattern (top right) with sharp discrete spots, six joined by a green dashed hexagon with green arrows on the spots.

Bright-field TEM micrograph with a 1 µm scale bar; a band delineated by two parallel blue dashed lines and labelled "shear band" in blue crosses the matrix; green arrows labelled "twins" mark twin laths; red-boxed label "A" indicates the area of the inset SAED pattern (top right) showing continuous concentric diffraction rings.
Bright-field TEM micrograph with a 1 µm scale bar showing dark, dense dislocation tangles and cell walls interleaved with lighter matrix regions, elongated along the deformation direction.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a dark-field TEM micrograph with a 200 nm scale bar at bottom right, showing bright elongated parallel lamellae on a dark background (interpreted as nano-twins).

The inset SAED pattern in panel (a) shows discrete sharp diffraction spots, six of which are connected by a green dashed hexagon with green arrows pointing at individual spots; no Miller indices are printed.
Panel (b) is a bright-field TEM micrograph with a 1 µm scale bar in which a band bounded by two parallel blue dashed lines is labelled "shear band" in blue text.
Green arrows labelled "twins" in panel (b) point to fine twin regions in the deformed matrix, above and below the shear band.

The inset selected-area diffraction pattern in panel (b), marked by the red-boxed letter "A" on the shear band, consists of continuous concentric rings around the central transmitted beam, indicating ultrafine/polycrystalline grains within the shear band.
Panel (c) is a bright-field TEM micrograph with a 1 µm scale bar showing dark, dense dislocation tangles and cell-wall structures interlaced with lighter matrix regions.

The caption states (a) is a dark-field image of nano-twins and (b) a bright-field image of a shear band, both after 70% cold rolling reduction, while (c) is a bright-field image of dislocation tangles after 90% cold rolling reduction.
The citing text states that at 70% reduction the twin size increased to 19.2 nm; no numeric twin size is printed anywhere in the panels.
The citing text states that the dislocation tangle structure of panel (c) has an average size of 0.49 µm; this value is not printed in the image.

The citing text states that the shear bands in panel (b) comprise ultrafine grains, confirmed by the inserted diffraction ring pattern, and were generated by localised strain concentration at a stress of ~1.8 GPa.

The citing text states that the dislocation cell structure seen in panel (c) becomes clearly observable at a stress of ~2.1 GPa, indicating that dislocation cross slip is operating at the higher rolling reduction.

unreadable_items: panel (a) inset SAED: spot indices/labels not printed, only green hexagon and arrows visible
panels (a)-(c): no numeric values (twin size 19.2 nm, tangle size 0.49 µm) appear in the images themselves; they come only from the citing text
